Method of Attack: Replacing Bitcoin wallet addresses on ransomware ransom payment sites with their own addresses to steal funds
Parsing Dark Web pages loaded via their portal for Bitcoin wallet address strings and substituting them
Impacted Systems: Ransomware ransom payment portals for ransomware families LockeR, Sigma, and GlobeImposter
Indicators of Compromise: Bitcoin wallet addresses operated by Onion.top team holding up to 2 Bitcoin (~$22,000)
Warning message on LockeR ransom payment site advising not to use onion.top due to address replacement
